gymkitchenhero Spicy Turkey Pasta Bake 🌶️
(Makes 3 Servings)

Macros:
- 520 Calories
- 55g Protein
- 48g Carbs
- 9g Fat

Ingredients:
- 1 Cup Cottage Cheese (0% Fat)
- 1/4 Cup Grated Parmesan
- 2 Tsp Cajun Seasoning
- 1/2 Cup Fat Free Milk
- 18oz Ground Turkey
- Garlic Salt
- 6oz Protein Pasta
- 1/2 Cup Diced Onion
- Red Pepper Flakes

#mealprep #highprotein
